launch_rules: No story enters the rundown without opening the original source.
Source-reported facts and WPA analysis remain visibly separate.
No unsupported breaking-news claim; uncertainty is stated explicitly.
No substantial third-party text/video/photo reuse without rights basis.
Every third-party visual gets a source strip and, where needed, ARCHIVE / ILLUSTRATION / AI label.
No community-support overlay during tragic, casualty, terrorism, active criminal-case or breaking security-emergency coverage.
No automatic external posting for the first pilot. Human Gate approval prepares the package; delivery is manual/authorised only.
